job.title: [Post] Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Senior Technical Architect | UK Remote ... looking for: -…

tailoring.headline: Senior Technical Architect – SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) | 5+ yrs E-Commerce Platforms
tailoring.summary: Seasoned backend engineer with 5+ years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in architecting end-to-end integrations, designing robust API layers, and driving cloud-native deployments. Proven track record of leading technical design, optimizing performance, and collaborating with international business and IT stakeholders in Agile environments.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) Senior Technical Architect
cover_en.hook: I am excited by your vision to push the boundaries of digital commerce on a global scale. With over five years of senior-level experience building and scaling SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in enterprise e-commerce architecture, API strategy, and cloud deployments that align perfectly with the Senior Technical Architect role.

bullets.label: **Enterprise Integration Architecture**
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and API migrations, ensuring seamless integration across SAP ERP, MDM and third-party systems for global e-commerce operations.

bullets.label: **Scalable API Design**
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services and headless APIs, supporting high-volume storefront and partner consumption while maintaining performance and security standards.

bullets.label: **Cloud-Native Deployment & Performance**
bullets.text: Led CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) using Docker and Kubernetes, optimizing runtime stability and reducing release lead-time.

bullets.label: **Techno-Functional Leadership**
bullets.text: Collaborated with international business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical specifications, user stories and functional designs, driving Agile delivery and production support.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany with a valid work permit, currently serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available to start 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

tailoring.why_company: Your commitment to delivering cutting-edge commerce experiences on Salesforce Commerce Cloud resonates with my passion for building scalable, integration-rich e-commerce platforms. I admire your focus on remote collaboration across the UK and Europe, and I am eager to bring my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to accelerate your clients' digital transformation and drive measurable business value.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud architecture experience to help your team deliver world-class SFCC solutions and drive innovative commerce outcomes.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior e-commerce architect with 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud. I’m keen to discuss how my integration and API expertise can add value to your SFCC initiatives. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior Technical Architect – Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC)
tailoring.email_body: Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Technical Architect position. With over five years of senior-level experience delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud solutions, I am confident I can contribute to your team’s success. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit further.
